name: What information do I need before getting a garage insulation quote?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need before getting a garage insulation quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: The strongest evidence is the condition of the garage itself: drafts, temperature swings, exposed framing, thin or missing insulation, and rooms above or beside the garage. If you want the most accurate recommendation, a pro should inspect the walls, ceiling, door, and any leakage points before quoting materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: You’ll want garage size, wall and ceiling condition, whether it’s attached, and where the drafts are. Photos or an on-site inspection help get a more accurate quote.
